title: Coaching is derived from judgments: task type enum, move from unmet guardrail, next-rung tip at the next task of the same type
prompt: Imran: is there anything else we can safely do in parallel? Coordinator: run /design-slice for turning judged rungs into coaching (next rung per recurring task type, in-the-moment tip on Copilot CLI / VS Code / Claude Code, Home 'Tasks agents finished: 41% could be 67%' card and Habits numbers; alpha packs Code a change and Write a spec or doc), cloud-only.
summary: Design docs/design/coaching-from-rungs.md and ADR-0008: judge picks a task type from a fixed per-job list; move = next rung's confidently unmet guardrail fact; tip at first pause of a live task whose type is guessed by nearest neighbour over the person's judged first prompts (self-checked, auto-off below 8 in 10); Home split, rows and habits derived; tip_feedback, guidance_flag, type_guess stored. One question to Imran (kept rule while F2 is unknown).
rationale: Deterministic, countable task types and moves; no model text on cards (TR-5); derive-don't-store so re-judgments and deletions never leave stale state; reuse the Phase 2 trigger engine, cap and quiet period
